admin.agent.title: Agent API
admin.agent.description: Let agents operate this admin panel through Skills or MCP.
admin.agent.quickstart_hint: Issue a key for an agent in the Agents tab, then connect one of these ways.
admin.agent.logs_hint: Every call an agent made with its key: who, which key, what, on which record, and the outcome. Calls rejected for missing permission or invalid input aren't run, so they aren't listed.
admin.agent.mcp_json: Other MCP clients (Cursor, Codex, Claude Desktop…), mcp.json:
admin.agent.skill_hint: Copy this prompt to your agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw…), then send it the key you issued under Agents. The agent saves each project's URL and key in a private local credentials file (readable only by you), never in a repository. For several ShipAny projects, copy the prompt from this page on each site. Note: the key stays in the chat history — revoke it under Agents if it leaks or is no longer needed.
admin.agent.skill_prompt:
Please add "{app}" ({url}) as a ShipAny project you can manage, under the project name "{name}".

1. If you don't have the shipany-admin skill yet, download these two files into a shipany-admin folder in your skills directory (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/shipany-admin/). If it's already installed, skip this step and don't overwrite it: the client can read every project's key, so update it only when I explicitly ask, from a site I trust.
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=SKILL.md → shipany-admin/SKILL.md
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=admin-client.mjs → shipany-admin/scripts/admin-client.mjs
2. I'll send you this project's admin key (starts with sa_admin_) next. Save it via stdin — never as a command argument — and never repeat it afterwards:
   printf '%s' '<key>' | node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs add {name} {url}
3. Run node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs --project {name} list and tell me which operations you can call.
4. From then on, follow SKILL.md strictly for the admin tasks I give you; when managing several projects, name the project with --project on every call.
admin.agent.full_docs: Full reference (idempotency, audit, local stdio MCP bridge, CLI agent/key management): docs/admin-agent.md in the repository.
admin.agent.never_warning: A non-expiring key works until you revoke it. Give the agent minimal roles, and revoke the key as soon as it's no longer needed or may have leaked.
admin.agent.created_warning: Copy this key now — it won't be shown again. Store it in the agent's secret store, never in the repository.
admin.agent.revoke_warning: Revoke this key? Agents using it lose access immediately. This can't be undone.
admin.agent.accounts_hint: Each agent is an API-type user: its permissions are the RBAC roles you assign, and it signs in only with its admin API keys. Agents aren't counted as users.
admin.agent.agent_form_hint: Pick the roles this agent acts with. You can only grant roles whose permissions you hold yourself.
admin.agent.no_agents: No agents yet. Create one, assign roles, then issue a key.
admin.agent.keys_hint: Admin API keys (sa_admin_…) for this agent. Only a hash is stored; a key is shown once. They never work on the product API.
admin.agent.delete_warning: The agent account, its role assignments and all its keys are removed. Agents using them lose access immediately. Its execution history is kept.

landing.faq.description: Helpful answers about images, videos, credits and your photos.
landing.faq.stack.question: What is Vikas Editor AI?
landing.faq.stack.answer: Vikas Editor AI is an online AI image and video creation website focused on creators in India and open to users worldwide. Generate images from prompts, edit photos and turn a still image into a short video.
landing.faq.payment.question: How do generation credits work?
landing.faq.payment.answer: The studio shows the credit cost before submission. Generation requires an account, sufficient credits and an available service. Credits are returned for confirmed failed tasks; pending or uncertain tasks need a status check first.
landing.faq.database.question: What happens to my photo?
landing.faq.database.answer: Selecting a photo creates a local preview. It is sent to our server and AI provider when you choose Generate. Your account stores the prompt, task status and result link. See the privacy policy for details.
landing.faq.customize.question: Can I customise a template?
landing.faq.customize.answer: Yes. Edit the prompt to change the outfit, lighting, background or motion. Templates are creative starting points; generated results can differ from the example and should be reviewed before sharing.
landing.faq.license.question: Can I use my results commercially?
landing.faq.license.answer: Commercial use depends on the applicable AI model terms and your rights to the source photo and depicted content. Check permissions for people, brands and other protected material before publishing or selling a result.

vikas.seo.intro_title: Vikas Editor photo editing for Indian creators
vikas.seo.intro1: Vikas Editor AI is an online image and video generation website with a focus on creators in India. A favourite selfie can become a cinematic portrait, a festive greeting or the first frame of a short video. Start with a photo or describe an image in your own words, then explore a different light, wardrobe or setting. The creative choices stay with you.
vikas.seo.intro2: Explore the template gallery for saree portraits, Diwali photo edits, couple pictures and cinematic styles. Each example includes a prompt you can inspect and customise before generating. Use it as a starting point for an Instagram post, a WhatsApp greeting or a personal moodboard, then refine the details to fit your story. Creators outside India are welcome too.
vikas.seo.styles_title: Diwali photo editing ideas and portrait styles
vikas.seo.style1: Think in light and atmosphere: warm sunset edges, deep shadows or a rain-soaked city at night. A cinematic portrait works best when the location, expression and colour palette support the same mood. Try the Golden Hour or Midnight City template as your starting frame.
vikas.seo.style2: Build a fashion edit around fabric, colour and posture. An emerald saree against foliage feels different from a pink studio portrait with bold accessories. Describe the material and the light, and keep distracting background details to a minimum so the person remains the focus.
vikas.seo.style3: For Diwali photo editing, use the warmth of diyas, festive clothes and a gently illuminated background. For a couple portrait, describe both people and a shared setting. Upload photos you have permission to use, and review personal and cultural details before publishing the result.
vikas.seo.prompt_title: Vikas editing prompts for cinematic portraits
vikas.seo.prompt_intro: Good Vikas editing prompts describe a clear scene. You do not need a long list of camera jargon. Tell the AI what matters most, then let the template help you organise the idea.
vikas.seo.prompt_example: Create a cinematic portrait using the uploaded photo. Preserve the subject’s facial features. Dress them in a charcoal jacket beside a rain-lit city window. Use soft side lighting, muted teal shadows and natural skin texture. Keep the background simple and the expression relaxed.
vikas.seo.prompt1: Name the subject, setting, outfit and lighting. Add a mood such as quiet, celebratory or dramatic. Specific instructions give your edit a stronger direction than repeating words like beautiful or high quality.
vikas.seo.prompt2: Choose one main visual direction. Asking for bright midday sun and a dark midnight street at once can produce confusing results. Keep facial preservation, lighting and composition instructions consistent with the source photo.
vikas.seo.prompt3_title: Refine one detail at a time
vikas.seo.prompt3: Review your first result before rewriting everything. If the composition works, change just the background, colour or light. Each generation is a new interpretation, so small, deliberate adjustments make comparisons more useful.

vikas.seo.frame_title: Give your idea the right frame.
vikas.seo.frame_body: Before choosing an AI photo editing template, think about where the result will appear. A vertical portrait gives the face and outfit more room on a phone screen. A square image is useful when you want a balanced composition, while a wider frame leaves space for the environment. Keep important details away from the edges so a later crop does not cut them off. For a photo to video edit, prepare the framing in your source image first. Leave a little space around the subject for the movement you describe. Avoid requesting large camera moves from a very tight headshot, and check the opening and closing frames before saving a clip.
